hook: Your agent decides to run rm -rf. What actually stops it?
bullets: PreToolUse hook on Bash, PostToolUse on everything
PreToolUse denies rm -rf before permissions run
The error steers Claude to a safe ls instead
{} means no objection, the command runs
PostToolUse audits only the call that ran
cta: Watch the flow, then go deeper in the full course:
shows: This short animation shows a hook blocking a dangerous rm -rf command and logging what ran.
